ledger: 00:00 - 00:03: Green olives poured from small jar (right hand) into large jar on counter.
00:03: Empty small jar placed on counter.
00:05 - 00:09: Second small jar of green olives picked up and poured into large jar.

findings.description: The olives in the small jar being poured are uniformly green. However, as they fall into the large jar, many of them are dark purple/black. The objects change appearance during the transfer.
Similar to the first pour, the olives in the second small jar are all green, but they land in the large jar as a mix of green and purple/black olives.
